name: Spotlight
author: Max Randhahn
description: A Raycast-style launcher for Omarchy. Spotlight launches applications, switches windows, finds files, searches clipboard history, runs Omarchy commands and toggles system settings such as Wi-Fi and night light from a single input. Natural-language input covers calculations, unit conversions, reminders and calendar events, and search prefixes route queries to sites such as YouTube and GitHub. Spotlight runs inside omarchy-shell and opens instantly, without a separate background process.
